name: claude-peer
description: Proactively collaborate with a Fable-first, max-effort Claude Code agent with observable model evidence and ordered Opus/Sonnet fallback.

interface.shortDescription: Fable-first Claude at max effort with verified fallback.
interface.longDescription: Adds a local Max-subscription bridge from Codex to a proactive full built-in Claude Code agent that can edit files, run commands, and use built-in web tools in approved workspaces. It defaults to Fable at max effort, exposes current aliases and exact model presets including Opus 5, configures ordered Opus/Sonnet availability fallback, and reports requested settings separately from observed per-model usage. It also includes six-follow-up read-only review, explicit no-round-cap modes, and one-use path-scoped worktree authorization for conservative edits.
defaultPrompt: Bring in the full Claude Code agent with Fable at max effort, verify the observed model evidence, and implement and test this with you.
Use Opus 5 at max effort for this task and report any model fallback.
Have Claude independently challenge this plan through the full default review depth.
Use unlimited full-agent back-and-forth with Claude and no numerical reply cap.
